claim: Frozen confirmatory comparison at qualified observed scope; hypothesis remains unproven. No population, live-latency, zero-day or fusion-superiority claim from development.

primary.interpretation: Report both outcomes and trade-off; no outcome-based winner selection. Seed7 was prespecified, not selected for performance.

secondary.selection: No promotion, refitting, new searches, C1 refit, threshold adjustment or epoch extension after final access.

development_limits: V is44 SYN-labelled seconds in40 runs from one recording, max2s; no observed TLS functionality or denial impact.
No matched benign target/source coverage; class/service/path confounding persists.
Main AE seeds reach100/100 epoch cap; convergence is unestablished.
h5 public C2 eligibility13/246, public V1/155. C2 empirical1% is not final/population FPR guarantee.
Hybrid recall varies20.45-88.64% across seeds; AE86.36-100%. Some AE/IF V FPR exceeds1%.

features.policy: Split/source first, core reset per group/observation segment, conservative50s start guard, omit partial tail, no cross-group state. Preserve full observed idle timeline; idle public truth stays unknown.

decisions.persistence: Frozen kth-largest trailing-h, gaps/invalid feature history =>unknown, never compress clock.
decisions.onset: New alert only after five preceding valid nonalerts. Startup/gap alarm is unqualified. Short off gaps remain same alarm episode. Unknown truth never changes decision state.
decisions.availability: Offline proxy=window end+1s fixed reorder=t+2. Measured live latency is a separate experiment.

windows.primary_support: Common5 consecutive valid raw feature seconds; current positive label suffices; benign requires all5 truth labels benign. Own-h support is secondary.
windows.unknown: y=-1 never a negative; report excluded known labels and all-known recall/FPR bounds.
windows.AP_AUC: Trailing decision statistic on stated eligible support; undefined without both classes.
windows.benign_burden: Qualified new-alert starts/hour on at least6 consecutive valid known-benign seconds; report startup and unattributed starts separately.

episodes.credit: Fresh qualified alert, originating window overlaps onset, availability<=onset+180s and<episode end; preexisting alarms get no immediate credit.
episodes.eligibility: Exact-onset primary denominator requires same common5 input support, recent pre-onset history and complete fixed min(180s,duration) observation, independent of detection outcome.
episodes.censoring: Incomplete/gapped episodes remain recorded, unscorable/censored, with bounds; fully observed misses remain misses, including ineffective attacks.
episodes.coarse_truth: Onset interval gets diagnostic possible/guaranteed bounds only, no invented point delay/binary primary hit.
episodes.delay: Penalty-coded restricted delay includes misses at min(180s,duration); detected-only median secondary. No inference of live speed from replay proxy.

uncertainty.unit: Pair models by session; average algorithm seeds within session, pool within parent, resample whole parent recordings within prespecified source/family/condition stratum.
uncertainty.unsupported: N/A with<2 independent parents per stratum, missing pairs/seeds, absent metric denominator or parent spanning strata. Never treat windows, rotations or seeds as independent.
uncertainty.claims: Descriptive conditional intervals; primary fixed-seed and secondary seed-averaged results separate. No multiple-comparison superiority claim.

qualification: After seal, predeclare source-specific acquisition/adapter hashes before payload access. Select endpoints/clock using provenance/count/label compatibility only, never scores. Record unsupported/failed units and outcome-independent exclusions. Shared all-week label archive envelope is not a blanket denial of unopened Wednesday member.

lab.session_policy: Fresh isolated private lab only; benign verification first.>=60s observed warmup, independent core reset, all legitimate failures remain benign. Retain ineffective attacks and planned failures; log actual rate/service impact/packet loss separately.
lab.duration: Final acquisition addendum must fix durations/measurement intervals, seeds, order, image/collector/adapter hashes and impact probes before any final traffic. No outcome-driven duration/intensity tuning.

scope: Detection/evaluation only; no mitigation/blocking. Costs of feature extraction/inference and actual live availability measured separately from fitting/task runtime.
